name: Explore deep link and navigator-key patterns

text:
In this Flutter monorepo (/Users/jace/Documents/newapp), I need to implement a custom app-scheme deep link (e.g. `glassesapp://realtime-communication/join?code=...`) that, when tapped, navigates the user into an existing GoRouter route inside `apps/glasses_app`.

Please investigate and report back:

1. Does `apps/glasses_app` (or any shared package it depends on) already have a global/root `GoRouter` instance, a `navigatorKey`, or any existing mechanism for navigating "from outside the widget tree" (e.g. for push notification taps, background task completion, etc.)? Look at `apps/glasses_app/lib/app.dart`, `apps/glasses_app/lib/app_shell/`, and search the whole repo for `GoRouter(`, `navigatorKey`, `rootNavigatorKey`, and any existing notification-tap-to-route wiring (e.g. in `core_notifications` or similar packages).
2. Is there ANY existing usage of the `app_links`, `uni_links`, or similar deep-linking package anywhere in the repo (pubspec.yaml files)? Search all pubspec.yaml files for `app_links`, `uni_links`, `flutter_deep_linking`.
3. How is `pushAuthRequired` (in `packages/feature/account/feature_account_auth/lib/src/routing/auth_route_helper.dart`) currently invoked across the codebase? Show 2-3 call sites with context (I already know its signature is `pushAuthRequired(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, String path)`).
4. Look at `apps/glasses_app/lib/app.dart` in full and summarize its structure: how is the root `MaterialApp.router`/`GoRouter` constructed, where are route groups from features registered (e.g. `realtimeCommunicationRoutes()`), and is there a top-level `Consumer`/`ConsumerStatefulWidget` wrapping the router that could add an `initState`/lifecycle hook to start listening to a link stream?
5. Check the Android manifest (`apps/glasses_app/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`) and iOS `Info.plist` (`apps/glasses_app/ios/Runner/Info.plist` or similar) for any existing custom URL scheme / intent-filter registrations (e.g. for OAuth redirect URIs like the Apple/Google auth redirect mentioned in AGENTS docs), which would show the established pattern/convention for adding a new scheme.
6. Check `pubspec.lock` or run a quick search for what version of `app_links` is available/commonly used, and confirm there's no existing deep-link-handling package already used for this purpose (e.g. check `core_base`, `common_ui` for a `DeepLinkService` or similar).

Report back with file paths + relevant line ranges/snippets for each finding, not full file dumps. This is a read-only investigation — do not make any edits.
I'll investigate the monorepo for GoRouter setup, deep-link packages, auth routing, and platform URL scheme config.
